licenseNote: MIT is declared in the upstream sdk/package.json. The upstream repo contains no LICENSE file at this commit, so none could be copied. Recorded here rather than silently assumed to be absent.
generatedFrom: Official TikTok Shop Open Platform reference docs (363 APIs / 25 categories). Covers TikTok Shop only; order and bill history for Tokopedia stays on the Tokopedia Open Platform and is not in this SDK (docs/adr/0003).
officialSpecSource: The TikTok Shop OAS published as @tts-open-toolkit/cli on npmjs.org is the authoritative machine-readable spec (405 paths, MIT). The vendored generated client is current against it as of this commit and is used because it provides types and signing; the OAS is used for drift checking, not runtime.
regenerate: Upstream has no release cadence we can rely on. To update: clone the upstream repo at the desired commit, run `npm install && npm run build` in `sdk/`, replace `dist/`, then run `pnpm --filter @platform/connector-tiktok-tokopedia vendor:checksums`.
doNotEdit: Vendored files are byte-identical to upstream and checked by CHECKSUMS.sha256. Put all adaptation in the connector source, never here. See docs/adr/0007.
